# d3-hierarchy 3.1.2

Vendored official UMD distribution, used only by the local chart experiment.
The `.cjs` extension supports CommonJS tests; the preview builder embeds the
same bytes as a browser script. No runtime network or npm installation needed.
Do not reformat third-party distribution code.
